decisions: Fixed operational stability criterion was selected before viewing this study. It is separate from the unchanged live promotion gate.
Exact disagreement zero gets no side, not an arbitrary home pick; exclude it from directional averages and ATS rates.
Bucket 3-4 includes exactly four points; over four is strict.
ATS intervals cluster within season; coefficient intervals cluster by season-week. All intervals are pointwise.
scope: Descriptive bucket study and prior-season regression complete; blend condition not met, no blend or promotion score fabricated.
